description: This source file defines types, components, and rendering logic for a document rendering system using React. It includes type definitions for document nodes, renderers for various block and inline elements, and a main DocumentRenderer component that renders a structured document based on provided node data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Recursively sets a value at a specified nested path within an object, creating nested objects as needed.

methods.name: createComponentBlockProps
methods.description: Creates properties for a component block node, integrating children React elements into the node's properties based on propPath instructions.

methods.name: DocumentRenderer
methods.description: Main React component that renders a document composed of node elements using specified renderers and component blocks.

methods.name: DocumentNode
methods.description: Recursive React component that renders a single document node (element or text) using the appropriate renderer or component based on node type.
